profile.headline: Full-Stack Engineer | React · TypeScript · Node.js | 8+ Years Building Production Web Applications
profile.summary:
I am a Full-Stack Engineer with 8+ years of production experience designing scalable systems and building polished user interfaces. I approach software engineering end-to-end, taking features from database schema design and event-driven microservices to modern web applications. 

Throughout my career at a Libsyn, I have owned major product initiatives across the entire stack, including leading high-impact UI modernizations using React Router 7 and TanStack, designing our event-driven quota microservice using Node.js and Kafka, and constructing our core onboarding milestone tracking database and API.

My engineering execution is backed by a unique background: a degree in Cognitive Psychology & Linguistics and early clinical research experience. This background informs how I design interactive data dashboards, tackle WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and optimize complex workflows so they make cognitive sense to users. Whether I am building real-time multiplayer WebSocket apps, writing asynchronous Python pipelines with AI integrations, or structuring systems with Feature Sliced Design and Domain-Driven Design, I strive to build clean, maintainable software designed to scale. I am seeking remote software engineering or full-stack roles where I can own systems from the data layer to the end-user experience.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer
positions.description:
Shipping full-stack products independently since leaving Libsyn, using Claude Code and Google Antigravity (Gemini CLI) daily as a working part of an actual agentic development practice, not just as occasional tools.
 
Recent projects include:
 
RepStash — a Gemini-powered pipeline (Python/FastAPI backend, Next.js/TypeScript frontend) that turns raw video into structured, user-editable data, with usage caps and full ingestion logging built in rather than trusting AI output blindly
 
Pittsburgh Trivia — a WebSocket-driven real-time multiplayer trivia app synchronizing game state across multiple phones
 
Hearth Huddle — a mobile-first pass-and-play party game app with six original games, built on the full TanStack suite (React 19, TanStack Start SSR, Router, Form) on Cloudflare Workers
 
DNL Arcade — a Turborepo monorepo of four browser games across three independently deployed Next.js apps
 
Full list and live demos at ldbennett.com

projects.title: Hearth Huddle
projects.description:
- Designed and built 6 original party games (social deduction, co-op improv, and voting formats) all playable pass-and-play on a single phone",
- SSR with TanStack Start (React 19) deployed to Cloudflare Workers via Wrangler for globally low-latency edge rendering",
- Type-safe file-based routing via TanStack Router with Framer Motion handling per-game animation sequences
- Working on making this not just a single phone pass and play, but multi-phone support as well

projects.title: D&D Dice Logger
projects.description:
Architected a lightweight, mobile-first statistical rolling web application using SvelteKit and Neon (Serverless Postgres). Applied Domain-Driven Design (DDD) & Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) principles to isolate core mathematical calculations and rolling domain logic from infrastructure and UI layers.
I thought it would interesting to tally my rolls and see how I've been rolling recently in session. I created this app  so I could really get a glimpse if I am having bad (or good) luck or if I am just perceiving it that way. It can log (or roll) my dice rolls and gives me a session by session breakdown. I have no opened this up to other users yet, but am considering doing so eventually.
